notes: The text has no clear heading for the award itself (it begins with the truncated 'utte Local'); the section_heading is taken from the program map heading.
Closed-list codes 'COS12' and 'COS29' (no space) are treated as the catalog's COS 12 and COS 29, not as catalog additions.
COS 21 Chemical Hair Services Practicum (5 units) is required in the catalog but missing from the closed list.
The closed list stores 4 units for COS 11; the catalog prints 1.00.

The degree total of 60-66 is taken from the program map ('Units: 60.00- 66.00', 'Total : 60.00- 66.00'). The general education areas are listed only as map choices, with no single GE unit total printed, so ge_units is null.

The 11-unit elective in Term 4 of the map ('any course numbered 1-199 or C1000-C2999') is recorded as degree_elective_units. The catalog says it is 'Only necessary if the 60 units needed to graduate have not been completed.'
The program description states a minimum 1,000-hour course of study, but the courses are listed in units, so the measure is units.
GE pattern recorded as Butte GE from 'Map (Butte GE)' and the 'Butte Local' fragment. The map also suggests taking a Cal-GETC course for electives.
